title: Rep. David Kustoff Disclosed a Warner Bros. Discovery Sale on the Same Day as Pelosi
content:
Rep. David Kustoff (TN-8) disclosed one stock sale on November 9, 2026: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), sold October 7 in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Oct 7WBDWarner Bros. Discovery, Inc.Sale, $1,001–$15,000not provided

Transaction date: Oct 7, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 9, 2026 (33 days later). Member: Rep. David Kustoff, TN-8 (House). Bargo gives no price estimate for this line.

What's been disclosed

  • One sale: Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD), $1,001–$15,000, on October 7.
  • Same stock, same day: Rep. Nancy Pelosi (CA-11) also disclosed a WBD sale dated October 7, in the $50,001–$100,000 band; see our separate post.
  • Price since: Bargo provides no price estimate for this transaction, so we do not show a comparison.
  • Timing: the filing came 33 days after the trade, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
33 days after the trade, which was dated October 7. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 10 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
